reason: E2 shows that hot rolling refines grains in Ti-rich MEAs, but it does not mention nano-scale precipitates or their stabilization by annealing; E1 discusses refractory HEAs without Ti–Ni systems or thermomechanical processing. The key premises about precipitate stabilization and high-temperature strengthening in Ti–Ni HEAs are unsupported by the cited evidence.
premises: Hot rolling refines grain size in Ti-rich MEAs
Grain refinement increases grain boundary density and impedes dislocation motion
Controlled annealing after hot rolling can stabilize nano-scale precipitates
Grain refinement and precipitation strengthening enhance high-temperature strength
Ti–Ni HEAs can be processed similarly to Ti-rich MEAs with minor Zr additions
